findings.title: Live Flow chaos only in nightly/manual (not PR CI)
findings.impact: Browser-against-live-Flow chaos scenarios are not run on every PR; regression coverage of those paths relies on mock browser + controlled nightly runs.
findings.mitigation: Controlled-environment receipts for all browser/session scenarios (mock browser); nightly live smoke bounded by credit cap (plan §20.2).

findings.title: ffprobe binary required for technical review on the host
findings.impact: CH06/CH07 real-media rejection depends on ffprobe presence.
findings.mitigation: VideoInspectionPolicy fails closed when the inspector is unavailable (VideoProbeUnavailableError); CI installs ffmpeg (present in the evidence run).
